title: One teen, two cultures
objective: Lire un court témoignage et en relever les informations essentielles

steps.title: Warm-up: where are you from?
steps.student_instruction: Name three countries and one language spoken there. Share with a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire émerger pays, nationalités et langues ; écrire au tableau come from / live in / speak.

steps.title: Watch: Talking about your family
steps.student_instruction: Watch Sam and Jack. Answer the three questions about Sam's half-brother.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Montrer la vidéo British Council (QR code du cahier) ; sans réseau, lire deux fois le script de secours. Faire repérer lieux, âge et fréquence des visites : transition vers la lecture d'un témoignage.

steps.title: Reading: Lucía's testimony
steps.student_instruction: Read Lucía's text. Underline who, where, when and one feeling.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Lecture silencieuse puis surlignage par couleur (personnes, lieux, moments, sentiments). Vérifier la stratégie : repérer avant de comprendre chaque mot.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : vrai/faux avec justification guidée ; B : questions ouvertes ; C : comparer avec sa propre vie. Ne pas traduire le texte : renvoyer au mot-clé.

steps.title: ID card and short presentation
steps.student_instruction: Fill in an ID card for Lucía (or a partner's text) and present her in three sentences.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Binômes ; observer l'usage de he/she + -s et la sélection des informations essentielles.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one thing Lucía loves and one thing she misses.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser et repérer les réponses qui recopient sans sélectionner.

sheets.student_content: True or false? Correct the false sentences with words from the text. (1) Lucía lives in Mexico. (2) She speaks Spanish at home. (3) She visits Mexico every winter.
sheets.facilitator_correction: (1) False: she lives in Manchester. (2) True. (3) False: she visits Mexico every summer.

sheets.student_content: Answer in full sentences: Where does Lucía's family come from? What does she do on Sundays? Who is her best friend? How does she feel about her two cultures?
sheets.facilitator_correction: Her family comes from Mexico. They eat tacos on Sundays. Her best friend is a girl from Poland. She loves her life in two cultures but she misses her grandparents.

sheets.student_content: Compare Lucía's life with yours in 6-8 sentences: languages, family traditions, friends, holidays. Use both, but and whereas.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : informations du texte exactes, comparaison explicite, connecteurs variés.

criteria: L'élève relève lieu, langue et fréquence dans le texte
L'élève résume le témoignage en trois phrases

common_errors: Recopier une phrase entière au lieu de l'information
She live au lieu de she lives
